attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 2 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the page, and it prints no hymn, no distich and no year. It says itself that he is unknown to the Synaxarist of Saint Nikodemos and is commemorated as Confessor on 2 December in Delehaye's; and it raises, without settling, the possibility that he is the same as a Moses the Steward whom the Parisian Codex 1578 mentions on 3 December. That guess is recorded here and not acted on: no folder is made or claimed for the 3 December entry.
